_comment: The embedding library and model memory search re-ranks with; boa install builds them into .boa/embed/ (memory_embed.py). Bump the library, the Python range it ships wheels for (python, inclusive), its constraints (upper major bounds on its direct dependencies) and the model together, as a periodic tooling task: check the release, the licence and the library's supported models on the primary sources, then the new revision and sha256 of every model file.
